g.text: cmd: just gateway-up | pass: prints 'gateway-up: ready'
cmd: just gateway-status | pass: prints 'GET /v1/models -> http 200'
cmd: just gateway-logs | pass: one 'request' record per call, status 200
cmd: edit gateway/agentgateway.yaml | pass: log shows 'loaded config' and container StartedAt unchanged (no restart)
cmd: backend stops answering | pass: gateway returns http 503 and logs an error record
cmd: backend restored | pass: just gateway-status prints http 200 again
cmd: just gateway-down | pass: podman ps -a --filter name=wattson-gateway lists nothing
cmd: just gateway-down | pass: podman ps -a --filter name=wattson-gateway lists nothing
